resume_rule: E1 RESUMABLE LAUNCHES (PLANNER_BRIEF_2026-09-13.md Addendum 86 ruling 3 iii): one launch per batch (default; a poll can exceed 4 h) or per evaluating poll; the seeds phase one batch of its own size per launch. The resume state is rebuilt ONLY from the phase root's own records (launch records + manifests, hash-chained; every point inside the phase root, its eval key recomputed under the arm's model, its model the arm's, re-derived from its own eval dir; no foreign file; git-tracked and clean at --run). The unchanged loop is replayed on those records up to the first batch needing a live evaluation; there its own k_next, new-evaluation count, barrier count, polls and incumbent must equal the last launch record, and the replayed polls must be byte-equal to the persisted ones; otherwise the launch is refused and nothing is written.
